units.source_text: 老头似听非听，茫然地晃了晃脑袋，仿佛身上有只撒娇的猫，他做了个掸落的动作。

en.t: The old man seemed half listening and half not, dazedly shaking his head, and, as if there were a spoiled cat clinging to him, made a gesture of brushing it off.

units.source_text: 说不定是在注意观察哨吧？

en.t: Perhaps he was keeping an eye on the lookout post?

units.source_text: 和男人说太多，难道有什么不妥之处吗？

en.t: Was there really anything wrong with talking too much to the man?
